concerns.location: plan.md: Section 2 – Model Training (loss definition) & Section 4 – Robustness Evaluation (ΔAcc definition)
concerns.text: The primary validation metric ΔAcc (accuracy drop between original and counterfactual videos) is directly optimized by the Counterfactual Consistency (CC) loss, which penalizes prediction changes on counterfactual pairs. Evaluating that the CC‑loss reduces ΔAcc is therefore circular: the model is trained to minimise exactly this quantity, so the reported improvement is guaranteed by definition rather than providing independent evidence that the model relies more on motion cues.
